metadata.title: Privacy Policy - LineME
metadata.description: Learn how LineME handles queue, visitor, and account information.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains how LineME handles information when teams create queues and visitors join them. It is written to be clear, practical, and easy to update as the product grows.

information.title: Information we collect
information.body: LineME may collect queue names, locations, join codes, visitor position details, manager account details, and contact information when it is needed for notifications or support.

usage.title: How we use information
usage.body: We use information to create and manage queues, show live positions, estimate wait times, send service updates, improve reliability, and protect the app from misuse.

sharing.title: When information is shared
sharing.body: We do not sell personal information. Information may be shared with service providers that help operate LineME, such as hosting, authentication, analytics, email, or SMS delivery.

retention.title: How long we keep information
retention.body: Queue activity should be kept only as long as needed for operations, audit, support, or legal requirements. Future account settings should allow teams to control retention where practical.

choices.title: Your choices
choices.body: Visitors can choose not to provide optional contact details, though some notifications may not work without them. Managers can request updates or deletion of account information by contacting support.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: For privacy questions, contact LineME at <emailLink>{email}</emailLink>.
